tau-ceti-e.x: Super-Earth in Tau Ceti where Ryland Grace and Rocky harvest natural Astrophage predators (Taumoeba).

gaia-1872046609345556480.x: Homeworld of the Tellarites in the 61 Cygni binary system and founding member of the United Federation of Planets.
Jungle frontier world orbiting 61 Cygni A settled by generation ships from the Santiago flotilla.
Stellar waypoint at 61 Cygni visited by the post-biological Carter-Zimmerman polis during their diaspora to escape the Lacerta supernova.
Massive, rapidly spinning oblate planet orbiting 61 Cygni A with surface gravity varying from 3 g at the equator to nearly 700 g at the poles, inhabited by centipede-like Mesklinites.
gaia-1872046609345556480.a: Hal Clement, Robert L. Forward, Allen Steele, Poul Anderson

io.x: Volcanic Jovian moon hosting the clandestine Protomolecule hybrid research facility in Caliban’s War.
io.a: James S. A. Corey (Daniel Abraham & Ty Franck)

io.x: Volcanic Jovian moon hosting the primary Earth Alliance jumpgate providing hyperspace access to the Solar System.
High-radiation corporate mining facility on Jupiter’s moon Io where Marshal William O’Niel uncovers a lethal amphetamine-smuggling conspiracy.

titan.x: Major Saturnian domed colony and high-gravity naval resort in the outer Solar System.
titan.a: James S. A. Corey (Daniel Abraham & Ty Franck)

titan.x: Commercial hydrogen mining colony on Saturn’s moon Titan supplying reaction mass across the Solar System in Imperial Earth.
Historic Saturnian colony beneath Titan’s dense nitrogen atmosphere dedicated to preserving pre-evacuation Earth traditions.
Serene estate beside the liquid methane seas where Winston Niles Rumfoord materializes and the robotic messenger Salo waits with the message from Tralfamadore.
Destination of the manned Gattaca exploration mission celebrating natural human triumph, and the supposed orbital haven colony in Oblivion.
Recruitment hub and home port of the Jupiter Mining Corporation vessel Red Dwarf where Dave Lister signed aboard as third technician.
Massive metropolis built on the shattered remnant of Titan where the Church of Unitology and EarthGov inadvertently trigger a horrific Necromorph convergence around the Site 12 Marker.
Site of ESA’s Huygens probe landing in January 2005, the most distant landing ever conducted in the Solar System.

gaia-1129149723913123456.x: M-dwarf 17.6 light-years away; Voyager 1 will make its closest approach (1.6 ly) in ~40,000 years.
